name: com.ultimaps/mcp
title: Ultimaps
description: Create choropleth, category and pin maps of countries, states, counties and ZIP codes as images.

environmentVariables.name: ULTIMAPS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key. Without one you get 30 maps per hour with attribution. A key raises the limits, and a Pro key adds SVG, larger PNGs and no attribution.
